evals.name: migrate-appPort
evals.prompt: Update my old devcontainer.json - it uses appPort which I heard is deprecated.
evals.expected_output: Modernized devcontainer.json with forwardPorts replacing appPort.

evals.name: migrate-extensions
evals.prompt: My devcontainer uses the old 'extensions' property. Can you modernize it?
evals.expected_output: Updated devcontainer.json with extensions moved to customizations.vscode.

evals.name: schema-version-update
evals.prompt: Update my devcontainer from schema version 1.0.0 to the latest.
evals.expected_output: devcontainer.json updated to latest schema with all necessary migrations.
